sentences.pt: Sofia tinha um restaurante pequeno, mas notório, no centro histórico do Recife.
sentences.en: Sofia had a small but well-known restaurant in the historic center of Recife.

sentences.pt: Depois de quinze anos, o cozinheiro principal tinha se aposentado, e ela precisava contratar outro antes do Carnaval.
sentences.en: After fifteen years, the head cook had retired, and she needed to hire another before Carnival.

sentences.pt: Ela recebeu dezenas de currículos, mas só dois candidatos chegaram à última etapa.
sentences.en: She received dozens of résumés, but only two candidates made it to the last stage.

sentences.pt: O primeiro, Bruno, tinha trabalhado em restaurantes premiados de São Paulo e de Lisboa.
sentences.en: The first, Bruno, had worked in award-winning restaurants in São Paulo and Lisbon.

sentences.pt: O currículo dele era abrangente e cheio de nomes famosos.
sentences.en: His résumé was wide-ranging and full of famous names.

sentences.pt: Na prova de cozinha, ele fez um peixe com molho de laranja e pimenta, num prato preto e fosco.
sentences.en: In the cooking test, he made a fish with orange and pepper sauce, on a matte black plate.

sentences.pt: O prato era sofisticado, bonito e, sem dúvida, gostoso.
sentences.en: The dish was sophisticated, beautiful and, without a doubt, tasty.

sentences.pt: Mas Sofia percebeu algo que a deixou apreensiva.
sentences.en: But Sofia noticed something that made her uneasy.

sentences.pt: Com os outros funcionários da cozinha, Bruno era ríspido e prepotente.
sentences.en: With the other kitchen staff, Bruno was curt and overbearing.

sentences.pt: Quando um jovem garçom deixou cair uma colher, Bruno o chamou de inútil na frente de todos.
sentences.en: When a young waiter dropped a spoon, Bruno called him useless in front of everyone.

sentences.pt: Depois, quando Sofia perguntou sobre o cardápio do restaurante, as respostas dele foram vagas e ambíguas.
sentences.en: Later, when Sofia asked about the restaurant's menu, his answers were vague and ambiguous.

sentences.pt: “Eu faria tudo novo”, disse ele. “Esse cardápio é antigo e um pouco banal.”
sentences.en: “I would do everything from scratch,” he said. “This menu is old-fashioned and a bit banal.”

sentences.pt: A segunda candidata, Letícia, era bem diferente.
sentences.en: The second candidate, Letícia, was very different.

sentences.pt: Tinha só vinte e seis anos e tinha trabalhado apenas num boteco do bairro e na cozinha da avó.
sentences.en: She was only twenty-six and had worked only in a neighborhood bar and in her grandmother's kitchen.

sentences.pt: Na prova, ela ficou hesitante no começo e perguntou se podia provar os temperos da casa.
sentences.en: In the test, she was hesitant at first and asked if she could taste the house seasonings.

sentences.pt: Depois, fez um caldo de peixe simples, mas com um sabor profundo e sutil.
sentences.en: Then she made a simple fish broth, but with a deep and subtle flavor.

sentences.pt: Ela era meticulosa: limpava a mesa a cada etapa e explicava cada escolha.
sentences.en: She was meticulous: she cleaned the counter at every step and explained every choice.

sentences.pt: Com os funcionários, foi cordial e paciente, e até ajudou o garçom a lavar a louça.
sentences.en: With the staff, she was friendly and patient, and even helped the waiter wash the dishes.

sentences.pt: Quando Sofia perguntou o que ela mudaria no cardápio, a resposta foi sucinta e pertinente.
sentences.en: When Sofia asked what she would change on the menu, the answer was brief and to the point.

sentences.pt: “Eu não mudaria quase nada. Os clientes voltam aqui porque se sentem em casa.”
sentences.en: “I would change almost nothing. Customers come back here because they feel at home.”

sentences.pt: “Talvez só colocasse mais legumes da feira e tirasse a sobremesa que ninguém pede.”
sentences.en: “Maybe I'd just add more vegetables from the market and drop the dessert that nobody orders.”

sentences.pt: À noite, Sofia conversou com o marido, Paulo, que era crítico de gastronomia.
sentences.en: That night, Sofia talked with her husband, Paulo, who was a food critic.

sentences.pt: “O Bruno sabe muito; o prato dele foi o melhor que eu comi este ano”, admitiu Paulo.
sentences.en: “Bruno knows a lot; his dish was the best I've eaten this year,” Paulo admitted.

sentences.pt: “Mas um restaurante não é só um prato. É a equipe, é o cotidiano.”
sentences.en: “But a restaurant isn't just a dish. It's the team, it's the day-to-day.”

sentences.pt: Sofia concordou. Para ela, ser educado com as pessoas era tão imprescindível quanto saber cozinhar.
sentences.en: Sofia agreed. For her, being polite to people was as essential as knowing how to cook.

sentences.pt: “Cozinhar bem se aprende; ser uma boa pessoa, nem sempre”, disse ela.
sentences.en: “Cooking well can be learned; being a good person, not always,” she said.

sentences.pt: Na manhã de segunda-feira, ela ligou para Letícia e ofereceu o cargo.
sentences.en: On Monday morning, she called Letícia and offered her the job.

sentences.pt: Letícia ficou tão surpresa que, por alguns segundos, não disse nada.
sentences.en: Letícia was so surprised that for a few seconds she didn't say anything.

sentences.pt: Seis meses depois, o restaurante tinha mais clientes do que nunca, e um crítico de São Paulo escreveu uma resenha sobre o caldo de peixe de Letícia, que ele achou incrível.
sentences.en: Six months later, the restaurant had more customers than ever, and a critic from São Paulo wrote a review of Letícia's fish broth, which he found amazing.

sentences.pt: Sofia pendurou a resenha ao lado da porta da cozinha.
sentences.en: Sofia hung the review next to the kitchen door.

questions.q: Como Bruno era com os funcionários?
questions.qEn: How was Bruno with the staff?

questions.q: O que Letícia mudaria no cardápio?
questions.qEn: What would Letícia change on the menu?

options: Porque cozinhava bem e era educada com as pessoas.

sentences.pt: Quando Felipe conseguiu um emprego no Rio de Janeiro, ele e a esposa, Camila, tiveram um mês para encontrar um apartamento.
sentences.en: When Felipe got a job in Rio de Janeiro, he and his wife, Camila, had a month to find an apartment.

sentences.pt: Eles moravam em Belo Horizonte, numa casa vasta com jardim, e sabiam que no Rio iam pagar mais por muito menos.
sentences.en: They lived in Belo Horizonte, in a spacious house with a garden, and knew that in Rio they would pay more for much less.

sentences.pt: Uma moça da imobiliária, Luíza, mostrou a eles seis imóveis em três dias.
sentences.en: A young woman from the real estate agency, Luíza, showed them six properties in three days.

sentences.pt: O primeiro ficava em Copacabana, a dois quarteirões da praia.
sentences.en: The first was in Copacabana, two blocks from the beach.

sentences.pt: Nas fotos, parecia lindo; na verdade, era escuro e úmido, e a cozinha era tão pequena que só uma pessoa podia entrar de cada vez.
sentences.en: In the photos it looked lovely; in reality it was dark and damp, and the kitchen was so small that only one person could go in at a time.

sentences.pt: O preço do aluguel, no entanto, era exorbitante.
sentences.en: The rent, however, was exorbitant.

sentences.pt: “Pagar isso por um quarto e sala seria inviável”, disse Camila, desanimada.
sentences.en: “Paying that for a one-bedroom would be unworkable,” said Camila, discouraged.

sentences.pt: O segundo, em Ipanema, era moderno e sofisticado, com uma janela enorme para o mar.
sentences.en: The second, in Ipanema, was modern and sophisticated, with a huge window facing the sea.

sentences.pt: Mas só o condomínio custava quase o mesmo que o aluguel do primeiro.
sentences.en: But the building fee alone cost almost as much as the rent of the first one.

sentences.pt: O terceiro foi o mais peculiar.
sentences.en: The third was the most peculiar.

sentences.pt: Era um apartamento num prédio antigo e tombado, num bairro afastado do centro, com janelas altas e escadas de pedra.
sentences.en: It was an apartment in an old, heritage-listed building, in a neighborhood far from the center, with tall windows and stone stairs.

sentences.pt: O proprietário, um senhor de oitenta anos que tinha sido artista, morava no térreo.
sentences.en: The owner, an eighty-year-old man who had been an artist, lived on the ground floor.

sentences.pt: Ele recebeu o casal com café e bolo e contou, com nostalgia, a história do prédio.
sentences.en: He welcomed the couple with coffee and cake and told, with nostalgia, the story of the building.

sentences.pt: O apartamento era bonito, mas precário: o chuveiro não esquentava, e a pintura estava desbotada.
sentences.en: The apartment was pretty but in poor condition: the shower didn't heat up, and the paint was faded.

sentences.pt: “Eu cobro um aluguel baixo, contanto que vocês cuidem bem do lugar”, disse o senhor.
sentences.en: “I charge a low rent, as long as you take good care of the place,” said the man.

sentences.pt: Felipe ficou animado, mas Camila foi mais sensata.
sentences.en: Felipe got excited, but Camila was more sensible.

sentences.pt: “Uma reforma vai custar caro, e quem paga somos nós.”
sentences.en: “A renovation is going to be expensive, and we're the ones who pay.”

glosses.vai custar caro: is going to cost a lot

sentences.pt: Os outros três imóveis foram dispensáveis: um ficava num beco sem luz, outro estava ao lado de um viaduto barulhento, e o último custava mais do que os dois ganhavam por mês.
sentences.en: The other three properties were easy to dismiss: one was in a dark alley, another was next to a noisy overpass, and the last cost more than the two of them earned per month.

sentences.pt: No fim da semana, eles ainda não tinham escolhido nada.
sentences.en: At the end of the week, they still hadn't chosen anything.

sentences.pt: Foi então que aconteceu algo inusitado.
sentences.en: That was when something unexpected happened.

sentences.pt: O senhor ligou para Felipe: “Meu neto é encanador. Se vocês quiserem, ele faz o conserto do chuveiro e da cozinha, e eu pago a metade.”
sentences.en: The old man called Felipe: “My grandson is a plumber. If you want, he'll do the repairs on the shower and the kitchen, and I'll pay half.”

sentences.pt: Camila não acreditou. “Por que o senhor faria isso por dois desconhecidos?”, perguntou.
sentences.en: Camila couldn't believe it. “Why would you do that for two strangers?” she asked.

sentences.pt: “Porque, de todas as pessoas que vieram aqui, vocês foram as primeiras que perguntaram a história do prédio”, respondeu ele.
sentences.en: “Because, of all the people who came here, you were the first who asked about the building's history,” he replied.

sentences.pt: Eles assinaram o contrato no mesmo dia, sem pesar os prós e os contras.
sentences.en: They signed the contract that same day, without weighing up the pros and cons.

sentences.pt: A reforma demorou um mês e trouxe alguns transtornos, mas valeu a pena.
sentences.en: The renovation took a month and brought some inconvenience, but it was worth it.

sentences.pt: Hoje, a sala tem uma cor azulada suave, e as janelas altas deixam entrar o sol da tarde.
sentences.en: Today the living room is a soft bluish color, and the tall windows let in the afternoon sun.

sentences.pt: Aos domingos, o casal toma café com o senhor do térreo, que conta histórias da cidade.
sentences.en: On Sundays, the couple has coffee with the man on the ground floor, who tells stories about the city.

sentences.pt: Felipe diz que eles acharam mais do que um apartamento: acharam um vizinho, quase um avô.
sentences.en: Felipe says they found more than an apartment: they found a neighbor, almost a grandfather.

questions.q: Qual era o problema do apartamento de Copacabana?
questions.qEn: What was the problem with the Copacabana apartment?

questions.q: Como estava o apartamento do prédio antigo?
questions.qEn: What condition was the apartment in the old building in?

questions.q: Por que o senhor quis ajudar o casal?
questions.qEn: Why did the old man want to help the couple?
options: Porque perguntaram a história do prédio.
